tools.name: DuckDuckGo Search
tools.description: Search the web using DuckDuckGo Instant Answers API. Returns instant answers, abstracts, and related topics for your query. Free to use without an API key.

noHtml.description: Remove HTML from text in results (default: true)

heading.description: The heading/title of the instant answer

abstract.description: A short abstract summary of the topic

abstractText.description: Plain text version of the abstract

abstractURL.description: URL to the source of the abstract

image.description: URL to an image related to the topic

type.description: Response type: A (article), D (disambiguation), C (category), N (name), E (exclusive)

relatedTopics.description: Array of related topics with URLs and descriptions
